home.aboutText: I am {{age}} years old and live in Berlin. I hold a bachelor's degree in Geoinformatics and subsequently completed a master's degree in Media Informatics. In my free time, I work on projects to improve my skills and learn new technologies. My main focus is on web and Android development, though during my studies I also gained valuable insights into machine learning and other areas such as requirements engineering.
